card.name: Dose wording before drug-interaction results
card.fires_on: The word single, or the unit mg or the start of TID/t.i.d., inside a stated dose in a drug-interaction study. It sits right where a dose is named, such as 'a single dose' or '500 mg t.i.d.'.

modes.label: Single before dose
modes.description: The word single in 'a single dose' of a drug in an interaction study.
modes.example: with a<< single>> dose of Coartem Tablets resulted in

modes.label: mg after amount
modes.description: The unit mg right after a dose number, before the dosage form.
modes.example: after administration of a 40<< mg>> oral dose.

modes.label: Start of TID
modes.description: The first letter of TID or t.i.d. after a dose in mg.

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted tokens (night, wild) look unrelated to the contexts.
card.plain: It marks the spot in a dose description where a single dose, a unit like mg, or a three-times-daily schedule is being stated.
